explanation: Nearly always high: D2 is 10 (8-9 after about trial 90), and GO is 9-10 until about trial 90, then falls to 5-7 by trials 95-99. D1 follows the previous trial: about 9 if it was a1 and rewarded or a2 and unrewarded, and about 5 if it was a1 and unrewarded or a2 and rewarded; after about trial 85, D1 drops to 0-3, mostly after a rewarded a2 trial.
